title: DEBATE: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Role-Playing LLM Agents in Multi-Agent, Long-Form Debates
reasoning: The paper features a dedicated component for evaluating and benchmarking agent behavior on topics related to 'Religion & Belief' and 'Morality & Social Norms'. Specific topics include the existence of angels, the role of faith versus science, and the ethical justification of suicide, abortion, and homosexuality. Furthermore, the demographic profiles for the agents include variables such as religiosity, 'Bible Belief', and 'Evangelical' status.
